A '''battle''' took place in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Trade Federation resistance|resisting]] portions of the company known as the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], under the command of [[Customs Vizier]] [[Marath Vooro]], at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Farstine]]. The battle was part of the [[Five Veils Campaign]], an Imperial campaign launched against members of the Trade Federation who refused to acknowledge the [[Imperial–Trade Federation treaty|treaty]] signed by [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Federation Viceroy]] [[Sentepeth Findos]] giving the Empire control of the Federation's resources. During the battle, Imperial [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Octavian Grant]] and his [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] smashed Vooro's forces, which consisted of [[Trade Federation fleet/Legends|Trade Federation Defense Fleet]] units and [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. The Imperial victory at Farstine was followed by Grant [[Battle of the Hook Nebula|capturing]] Vooro in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Hook Nebula/Legends|Hook Nebula]].<ref name="War" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', an extensive [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|guide]] dedicated to the conflicts in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] and released in [[2012]].<ref name="War" />
